taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-19, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.2 | 25.53 | 25.53
2 | 7309.9 | 22.02 | 47.55
3 | 4367.7 | 0.42 | 47.97
4 | 4556.7 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for the given station, we analyze the resistivities of the layers in order:

1.  **Identify the layer resistivities:**
    *   $\rho_1 = 609.2$ ohm-m
    *   $\rho_2 = 7309.9$ ohm-m
    *   $\rho_3 = 4367.7$ ohm-m
    *   $\rho_4 = 4556.7$ ohm-m

2.  **Analyze each group of three consecutive layers:**
    *   **Group 1 (Layers 1-2-3):** $\rho_1 = 609.2$, $\rho_2 = 7309.9$, $\rho_3 = 4367.7$.
        The relationship is $609.2 < 7309.9 > 4367.7$ ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$).
        According to the rules, $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$ corresponds to the letter **K**.
    *   **Group 2 (Layers 2-3-4):** $\rho_2 = 7309.9$, $\rho_3 = 4367.7$, $\rho_4 = 4556.7$.
        The relationship is $7309.9 > 4367.7 < 4556.7$ ($\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$).
        According to the rules, $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$ corresponds to the letter **H**.

3.  **Combine the letters:**
    The sequence of letters in depth order is KH.

{"curve_type": "KH"}
